gizmo.title: Chithunzi kuchokera ku zolemba
gizmo.description: Lembani chithunzi ngati zolemba (Mermaid): chithunzi cha kayendedwe, motsatizana, mndandanda wa nthawi ndi zina. Chimajambulidwa patsamba ndi zolemba zina m'malo mwake.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Chimawonetsedwa pamwamba pa chithunzi ndipo chimagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati dzina lake.

configure.title: Gwero la chithunzi
configure.description: Zolemba za Mermaid, mwachitsanzo: flowchart TD, kenako mzere umodzi pa ulalo uliwonse monga A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Onjezani |label| pambuyo pa muvi kuti muupatse chilembo. Chojambula chimasinthidwa pamene mukulemba.

configure.title: Zolemba zina m'malo mwake
configure.description: Fotokozani zomwe chithunzi chikuwonetsa kwa anthu omwe sangathe kuchiwona. Siyani chopanda kanthu pa chithunzi cha kayendedwe kuti masitepe ake alembedwe m'malo mwanu.

configure.title: Mawu ofotokozera
configure.description: Mawu ofotokozera osankha owonetsedwa pansi pa chithunzi.

configure.title: Onetsani gwero
configure.description: Onetsani zolemba za chithunzi pambali pa chojambula.

configure.title: Onetsani zolemba zina
configure.description: Onetsani zolemba zina pansi pa chojambula. Zimapezeka nthawi zonse kwa owerenga sikirini.

advanced.title: Fayilo ya gwero
advanced.description: Adiresi ya fayilo ya .mmd yoti ijambulidwe m'malo mwa zolemba zili pamwambapa (https kapena njira pa tsamba ili).

advanced.title: Mtundu wowonetsa
advanced.description: Mtundu wa chip cha chizindikiro pamutu.
